title: Determinant-based output string
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define its determinant-based output string by applying the modular determinant algorithm to the pair encoding of the bits of the Lovász prime associated with the length of $tU(z)$ and the encoded data formed from $tK(z)$, the chunked pair encoding of $tU(z)$ and $tW(z)$, and the chunked pair encoding of $tNK(z)$ and $tCoins(z)$, combined entrywise with the Lovász row encoding.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definitions of the encoding functions, the associated quantities, and the modular determinant algorithm, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be recovered.
